code='''def transform(grid):
    # Two panels are separated by a uniform line; mark locations where both panels contain their non-background symbol.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if any(all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)):
        c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
        left, right = [row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
        bg1 = max(set(v for row in left for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
        bg2 = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))
        a = next((v for row in left for v in row if v != bg1), bg1)
        b = next((v for row in right for v in row if v != bg2), bg2)
        out = [[bg1 for _ in range(min(len(left[0]),len(right[0])))] for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h):
            for j in range(len(out[0])):
                if left[r][j] == a and right[r][j] == b: out[r][j] = 3
        return out
    # horizontal separator: use two regions' coincident foreground cells
    sep = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bot = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    bg1 = max(set(v for row in top for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in top for x in row))
    bg2 = max(set(v for row in bot for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in bot for x in row))
    a = next(v for row in top for v in row if v != bg1)
    b = next(v for row in bot for v in row if v != bg2)
    out=[[bg1]*len(grid[0]) for _ in range(min(len(top),len(bot)))]
    for r in range(len(out)):
        for c in range(len(out[0])):
            if top[r][c]==a and bot[r][c]==b: out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''

    if any(all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]==0 for c in range(w)):
